document.title: National Universal Free Healthcare and Medical Integrity Bill, 2026

claims.text: The State has a constitutional obligation under Article 21 to provide timely medical treatment to preserve human life.

authorities.title: Paschim Banga Khet Mazdoor Samity v. State of W.B.

claims.limitations: Establishes constitutional duty of public hospitals to provide emergency care.

claims.text: Article 47 mandates the State to treat the improvement of public health as among its primary duties.
claims.limitations: Directive Principle of State Policy; statutory enactment gives enforceable effect.

claims.text: Price regulation of private healthcare establishments is constitutional under reasonable restriction principles.

authorities.title: Modern Dental College v. State of M.P.

claims.limitations: Requires transparent cost-plus tariff determination by an independent statutory authority.
